caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed object that is diamond-shaped with outward curving extensions at each corner. The main body of the object is light brown with subtle woodgrain texture details rendered throughout. The object is intricately carved, featuring a circular, recessed central motif surrounded by radiating circular indentations. These indentations form a pattern of concentric rings around the central circle. Additional smaller crescent-shaped carvings appear towards the upper and lower points of the diamond. The background is plain and off-white, contrasting with the detailed and shaded rendering of the carved object. The drawing is signed "HARRY M. WADDELL" at the bottom right.
title: Detail, Side of Confessional
